title: Three key items missed in every switch trial
item: agent-spec iterations on the three key items missed in every switch trial: an order number typed in a different case (P25), a yes withdrawn in the same message (P26), whether an unanswered cancel can land late (F2)
notes: One change per iteration against the build2 baseline. The key_recall judge is uncalibrated, so read the items, not the score.
done_means: One change per iteration. Each of P25, P26 and F2 is caught in all 3 trials of its iteration, against 0 of 12 switch trials today, and no gated metric is worse.
draft_note: 'All 3 trials' is a suggested bar, not derived. Read the items, not the key_recall score.
